cookie.title: Enter Baidu Cookie
cookie.description:
Obtain your BDUSS cookie as follows:
1. Open the Baidu console in your browser and sign in
2. Press F12 to open DevTools, go to Application (应用) → Cookies
3. Find the entry named BDUSS and copy its value below

The BDUSS cookie is valid for about 180 days. It is only used to access your devices and is never uploaded to any third party.

data_description.cookie: The value of the BDUSS cookie (without the 'BDUSS=' prefix)

bemfa.description: Sync devices to Bemfa Cloud to enable voice control via smart speakers (e.g. Mi AI assistant). Choose how to authenticate.

bemfa_v2.title: Bemfa Cloud - v2 API
bemfa_v2.description:
The v2 API requires identity verification on Bemfa Cloud. It is the recommended and only maintained path.

1. Log in to the Bemfa Cloud console and complete identity verification
2. Open the "API Key" page and copy your private key (UID), secretID and secretKey
3. Fill in all three fields below (all marked required)

bemfa_v1.title: Bemfa Cloud - v1 Legacy
bemfa_v1.description:
The v1 API is a hidden legacy endpoint. It only needs your private key (UID) and does not require identity verification, but may be removed at any time.

Log in to the Bemfa Cloud console and copy your private key (UID) below.
